visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a long, vibrant red evening gown with a high leg slit is playing a silver flute. She is the central figure, smiling while performing. Behind her, in a large, luxuriously lit banquet hall, several men in dark business suits and ties are dancing enthusiastically, waving their arms in the air. The hall features tall marble pillars and elegant tablecloth-covered tables with guests seated in the background. (2) The camera moves slightly, showing more of the dancing men who are now pointing upwards and moving in rhythm. A digital quiz graphic with three Japanese text options is overlaid in the lower-right foreground. The lighting is warm and bright, typical of a high-end event space. (3) The performance continues as the woman turns slightly to interact visually with the dancers behind her. The dancers increase their movement intensity, smiling and laughing. The setting remains consistent with people in the background watching and filming the performance with their phones.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: POV: 当演出宾客来自日本 When your guests are from Japan. (2) [Variety]: GUESS THE SONG. [Variety]: A: 恋は続く. [Variety]: B: 世界に一つだけの花. [Variety]: C: さくら.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A luxury banquet hall or ballroom featuring high ceilings, large pillars with decorative metal panels, and round dining tables set with white linens and glassware. The flooring is a patterned grey carpet.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, melodic flute solo playing an upbeat, recognizable tune. Underneath the flute, an electronic pop backing track with a steady, driving kick drum and synthesized bass provides a high-energy rhythm. (2) Rhythmic hand clapping from the audience enters the mix, perfectly synchronized with the beat of the music. Distant cheers and whistles from a male-dominated crowd are heard, indicating high excitement. (3) The flute continues a soaring melody as the volume of the crowd's cheering swells. There is no spoken dialogue, only the instrumental performance and the enthusiastic atmospheric reactions of the guests, creating a festive, celebratory acoustic environment.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a high-energy, interactive musical performance during a banquet, highlighting the enthusiastic response of Japanese guests to a flute cover of a popular song.
